name: 15108 · Coraopolis, PA
findings: ZIP 15108 (Coraopolis) has 152 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15108 (Coraopolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
